statement: A Cid is carried as a 32-byte byte-string (major type 2); it carries neither a tag nor self-description (sem: SEM-gx-canon-133)
origin: gx self-authored; the hex was hand-assembled from RFC 8949 §3's major-type/additional-info table and 42 §2.1's six rules (not copied from encoder output) (sem: SEM-gx-canon-134)
note: 42 §1.1: "embedded as binary (inside DAG-CBOR) it is stored directly as a 32-byte byte-string (major type 2)". Not an array of 32 integers. (sem: SEM-gx-canon-135)
